sentences.en: ADVISER: Good morning, how can help you?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 早上好，有什么可以帮您的？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Good morning.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 早上好。

sentences.en: Umm, I understand you help fix up students with host families.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我听说您能帮学生安排寄宿家庭。

sentences.en: ADVISER: That's right .. are you interested in ...?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 没错……您对此感兴趣吗？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Yes . . .
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 是的……

sentences.en: ADVISER: Well please sit down and I'll just take a few details.
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 好的，请坐，我先记录一些基本信息。

sentences.en: STUDENT: Thank you.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 谢谢。

sentences.en: ADVISER: Right now.
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 好的，现在开始。

sentences.en: what name is it?
sentences.zh: 您叫什么名字？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Jenny Chan.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 珍妮·陈。

sentences.en: ADVISER: Can you spell that please?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 您能拼一下您的名字吗？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Yes . . .
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 可以……

sentences.en: L-E-N-N-Y C-H-A-N.
sentences.zh: L-E-N-N-Y，C-H-A-N。

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: ADVISER: Right ... and what is your present address?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 好的……您目前的住址是？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Sea View Guest House, 14 Hill Road.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 海景宾馆，希尔路14号。

sentences.en: ADVISER: OK, and do you know the phone number there?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 好的，您知道那里的电话号码吗？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Yes . . .
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 知道……

sentences.en: I have it here, ummm ...2237676, but I'm only there after about 7 pm.
sentences.zh: 我这儿有，嗯……2237676，但我通常晚上7点以后才在那儿。

sentences.en: ADVISER: So when would be the best time to catch you?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 那您什么时候最方便接听电话呢？

sentences.en: STUDENT: I suppose between 9 and, let me see, half-past, before I leave for the college.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 我想大概在9点到……让我看看……六点半之前吧，我得赶去学院。

sentences.en: ADVISER: Great ... and can I ask you your age?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 很好……请问您的年龄是？

sentences.en: STUDENT: I've just had my nineteenth birthday.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 我刚满十九岁。

sentences.en: ADVISER: And how long would you want to stay with the host family?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 您希望在寄宿家庭住多久？

sentences.en: STUDENT: I'm planning on staying a year but at the moment I'm definitely here for four months only.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 我计划住一年，但目前确定只住四个月。

sentences.en: I have to get an extension to my permit.
sentences.zh: 我需要为我的居留许可申请延期。

sentences.en: ADVISER: You're working on it?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 您已经在办理了？

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: and what will be your occupation while you're in the UK?
sentences.zh: 您在英国期间的职业是什么？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Studying English?
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 学习英语。

sentences.en: ADVISER: And what would you say your level of English is?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 您觉得自己的英语水平如何？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Umm.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 嗯……

sentences.en: Good, I think I'd like to say 'advanced' but my written work is below the level of my spoken, so I suppose it's intermediate.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己水平不错，想说是‘高级’，但书面表达能力不如口语，所以大概算‘中级’吧。

sentences.en: ADVISER: Certainly your spoken English is advanced.
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 您的口语水平确实是高级。

sentences.en: Anyway, which arca do you think you would prefer?
sentences.zh: 那么，您倾向于住在哪个区域呢？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Ummm, well I'm studying right in the centre but I'd really like to live in the north-west.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 嗯……我正在市中心学习，但我很想住在西北区。

sentences.en: ADVISER: That shouldn't be a great problem . .. we usually have lots of families up there.
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 这应该不是大问题……我们通常在那边有很多寄宿家庭。

sentences.en: ADVISER: And do you have any particular requirements for diet?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 您对饮食方面有什么特别要求吗？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Well, I'm nearly a vegetarian . . . not quite.
sentences.zh: STUDENT: 嗯，我几乎是个素食者……但又不完全是。

sentences.en: ADVISER: Shall say you are?
sentences.zh: ADVISER: 那我们就登记为素食者，可以吗？

sentences.en: It's probably casier that way.
sentences.zh: 那样可能更简单些。

sentences.en: STUDENT: That would be best.
sentences.zh: 学生：那样最好。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com 7.3-00
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 7.3-00

sentences.en: ADVISER: Anything about your actual room?
sentences.zh: 顾问：关于您实际住的房间，有什么要求吗？

sentences.en: STUDENT: would prefer my own facilities - *en suite', is that right?
sentences.zh: 学生：我更希望拥有独立卫浴设施——也就是‘套间’，对吗？

sentences.en: And atolfinoSage.com possible a TV and I'd also like the house to have a real garden rather than just a yard, somewhere I could sit and be peaceful.
sentences.zh: 而且，atolfinoSage.com 网站上显示，最好能配一台电视机；另外，我还希望房子带一个真正的花园，而不仅仅是一个小院子，这样我就能有个安静的地方坐一坐。

sentences.en: ADVISER: Is that all?
sentences.zh: 顾问：就这些了吗？

sentences.en: STUDENT: Well ...
sentences.zh: 学生：嗯……

sentences.en: I'm really serious about improving my English so I'd prefer to be the only guest if that's possible?
sentences.zh: 我真的很想提高英语水平，所以如果可能的话，我希望成为房主家唯一的寄宿生。

sentences.en: ADVISER: No other guests Yes, you get more practice that way.
sentences.zh: 顾问：不接待其他寄宿生？好的，那样您练习的机会确实会更多。

sentences.en: Anyway, obviously all this is partly dependent on how much you're willing to pay.
sentences.zh: 不过，显然所有这些在一定程度上还取决于您愿意支付的费用。

sentences.en: What did you have in mind?
sentences.zh: 您心里大概有怎样的预算呢？

sentences.en: STUDENT: was thinking in terms of about £60-£80 a week, but I'd go up to a hundred if it was something special.
sentences.zh: 学生：我原本考虑的是每周60至80英镑，但如果条件特别好，我也愿意提高到每周100英镑。

sentences.en: ADVISER: Well I don't think we'd have any problems finding something for you.
sentences.zh: 顾问：嗯，我想我们为您找到合适的住所应该不会有什么问题。

sentences.en: STUDENT: Oh, good.
sentences.zh: 学生：哦，太好了。

sentences.en: ADVISER: And when would you want it for?
sentences.zh: 顾问：那么，您希望什么时候入住呢？

sentences.en: STUDENT: I'd like to move in approximately two weeks.
sentences.zh: 学生：我希望大约两周后搬进去。

sentences.en: ADVISER: Let me see, it's the 10th today . .. so if we go for the Monday it's the 23rd March.
sentences.zh: 顾问：让我看看，今天是10号……那么如果我们定在下周一，就是3月23日。

sentences.en: STUDENT: Yes
sentences.zh: 学生：对。

sentences.en: ADVISER: Right ... good, and if I could ask one last question ...
sentences.zh: 顾问：好的……很好。最后再问您一个问题……
